text:
Alex: FYI staging promotion auto-held by deploy-bot. CI failing on artifact publish step after a cache eviction spike.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused: upstream artifact upload failed (partial write). See logs: /var/log/deploy/promote-4765432100.log

Chen: I saw a few uploads aborting with `EPIPE` and `chunked write failed` earlier. Could be transient network or registry throttling.

Sara: Link to the failed job: https://ci.redwood.example/12345 — artifact size 1.2GB, outsized compared to usual 800MB. uploads consistently failing at ~350MB.

PJ: Hmm that smells like multipart upload/keepalive timeout. Any retries configured?

Alex: CI runs `artifact-uploader v2.3` which does 4 parallel parts. The uploader log shows `Part upload 2: 499 Unexpected EOF`.

Natalie: Quick question — do we want to wait for CI re-runs or pin the last known-good image to unblock canary? Change window at 18:00 UTC.

Chen: If it's registry-side, re-runs will likely hit the same problem. I recommend pin to last stable: sha:abc123def and manually promote to canary. That unblocks front-line testing.

Sara: +1 to pin. Also we should collect full uploader debug from the node that failed: `curl -sS http://ci-agent/metadata && journalctl -u uploader -u docker --no-pager -n 200` and attach.

PJ: If we pin, we should also add a short-lived gate so auto-promo doesn't try again until we fix the uploader. deploy-bot, can you set hold reason?

deploy-bot: Hold applied by request: reason="partial-artifact-upload" initiator="PJ". Auto-promo disabled for tag v1.4.2 until manual clearance.

Alex: Action items: 1) Chen to promote sha:abc123def to canary manually. 2) Sara to collect uploader debug + registry team ping. 3) Me/PJ to add rollback notes and hold in release doc.

Chen: Manual promote command I used before: `gcrctl promote --from-sha abc123def --to-tag canary --reason "staging hold"` — will run now.

Sara: I attached logs in the CI job. Noticed repeated `503 slow_down` from registry at same time window. Opening ticket with registry ops (INC-8879).

PJ: Added a note in the release tracker: "hold - artifact partial upload / registry 503s" and changed release status to HOLD. Also added temporary override to prevent auto-promo.

Alex: Once Chen confirms canary promote succeeded, we can allow limited smoke testing. If smoke passes, we keep hold on full release and schedule a focused rollback/repair next ops window.

Chen: Promote complete. canary -> sha:abc123def. Smoke queue started.

Natalie: Smoke tests running. If they pass, we'll update release notes to say hold for full rollout due to registry issues; include mitigation steps and timeline.

Sara: Registry ops acked receipt of INC-8879, investigating throttling origin (edge proxy). They suggest retrying uploads with `--part-size 16M --max-retries 8`.

PJ: For unblock decision: if smoke passes in 30m, we keep canary live and schedule full-release retry after registry confirms fix or we switch uploader config. Otherwise rollback to previous tag across regions.

Alex: Agreed. I'll coordinate the post-mortem. For now release notes: DO NOT PROMOTE v1.4.2. Status: HOLD.

Natalie: Noted. I'll update the release doc and ping growth for customer comms draft (short heads-up).

Chen: tagging @registry-team in the ticket and will try a retry with the new part-size in a non-blocking pipeline to validate.

PJ: Thx everyone. If anything changes ping #oncall. :thumbsup:
